title: How Does Wireless Charging Actually Work?
sources: All About Circuits, 'An Overview of Wireless Charging' (2015): an alternating current in the transmitter coil generates a magnetic field, which induces voltage in the receiver coil; the receiver converts it into current to charge the battery; misaligned coils lose efficiency and waste heat; wireless charging is considered slower than wired

Wireless Power Consortium, 'How Magnetic Phone Chargers Work': the charger's magnetic field reverses direction thousands of times per second; a centimetre off and charging slows down while the missed energy turns into heat; Qi2 magnets snap the phone into alignment
eeNews Europe, 'Wireless power transfer breaks all connections, part 2' (2015): in the late 1990s inductive charging reached homes in Braun Oral-B and Sonicare electric toothbrushes
Basic physics: Faraday's law of electromagnetic induction (a changing magnetic field induces a current in a nearby coil)

lines.text: How does your phone charge just lying on a pad?
lines.caps: HOW DOES YOUR *PHONE | *CHARGE | JUST LYING ON A *PAD?

lines.text: Well, inside the pad there's a flat coil of wire,
lines.caps: WELL INSIDE THE *PAD | THERE'S A FLAT *COIL | OF *WIRE

lines.text: and electricity rushing back and forth through it
makes a magnetic field that flips thousands of times a second.
lines.caps: MAKES A *MAGNETIC | *FIELD | THAT *FLIPS | *THOUSANDS OF TIMES | A *SECOND

lines.text: Your phone hides its own coil in the back,
lines.caps: YOUR PHONE *HIDES | ITS OWN *COIL | IN THE *BACK

lines.text: and the flipping field pushes power through it, no wires touching.
lines.caps: AND THE *FLIPPING FIELD | *PUSHES | *POWER | THROUGH *IT | NO WIRES *TOUCHING

lines.text: That's induction, and it fills your battery.
The catch? The coils have to line up.
Slide it off centre and charging slows, wasting energy as heat,
lines.caps: SLIDE IT OFF *CENTRE | AND CHARGING *SLOWS | WASTING *ENERGY | AS *HEAT

lines.text: so newer pads use magnets to snap it in place.
lines.caps: SO *NEWER PADS | USE *MAGNETS | TO *SNAP IT | IN *PLACE

lines.text: The twist: your toothbrush has charged this way for decades.
No plug, no contact, just two coils and a magnetic field.
lines.caps: NO *PLUG | NO *CONTACT | JUST TWO *COILS | AND A MAGNETIC *FIELD
